WITH group_counts AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
  FROM Employee
  WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
), shares AS (
  SELECT ReportsTo,
         employee_count,
         1.0 * employee_count / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM group_counts
)
SELECT ReportsTo,
       employee_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_minus_average
FROM shares
ORDER BY share_minus_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
